poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE ILLUSION WAS ALWAYS JUST A REFLECTION OF YOUR OWN FEARS
poetryFrame.rightVertical: I AM FINALLY LEARNING TO TRUST THE SHARP EDGE OF MY OWN TRUTH
poetryFrame.bottomLine: THIS IS WHERE THE USES FEELINGS END
sonnetLines: The velvet curtain of your lies has dropped,
Leaving the bare stage for morning's cold light.
I trace the pattern where my trust was stopped,
A fragile mosaic against the coming night.
You wore a mask that shimmered and seemed real,
But dust collects on every gilded edge.
I gather strength from what I now can feel,
Beyond your whispered promise or soft pledge.
The whispers fade into a steady hum,
A quiet rhythm of my own return.
Of promises you never thought would come,
The lessons that the hard heart must learn.
So watch me step out where the shadows cease,
And find my difficult, essential peace.
